items.title: Microduck Obstacle Avoidance: A Sim2Real Workflow with Isaac Lab and Newton
items.reader_summary: Add local obstacle avoidance to Microduck while keeping its walking policy fixed. Build varied courses with reusable SimReady assets, model ToF sensing with Newton’s raycaster, and train a controller in Isaac Lab to adjust gamepad velocity commands around obstacles. This tutorial covers simulation training, evaluation, export, and real-robot deployment.

items.title: OpenAI o1 co-creator Noam Brown urges promising students to drop out as AI enters a "very steep rate of progress"
items.summary: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown is urging promising students to drop out, saying it's "not a great time to sit on the sidelines." The o1 co-creator says AI is still in a "centaur period" and struggles with planning and self-correction, though he expects a "very steep rate of progress" soon. According to Brown, language models are already being used to build the next generation of models. The article OpenAI o1 co-creator Noam Brown urges promising students to drop out as AI enters a "very steep rate of progress" appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，AI自動審查、修正及核准程式碼
items.summary: Anthropic週一（11/23）宣佈推出Claude Ship，將AI程式開發的自動化範圍從撰寫程式碼延伸至軟體交付流程，讓AI能夠自動審查及修正程式碼，甚至依據企業的自定政策來核准程式碼的變更，目前開放Claude Team及Enterprise使用者測試。 隨著愈來愈多開發人員使用AI代理人撰寫程式碼，後續的人工審查及核准流程可能成為軟體開發的瓶頸。Anthropic表示，旗下Claude Code團隊的大部分程式碼已由Claude撰寫，為了加快提交程式碼後的處理流程，開發了Claude Ship。

items.title: 雲端服務Rackspace Spot遭入侵，攻擊者可讀取客戶叢集內的機密資料
items.summary: Rackspace託管式Kubernetes平臺Spot憑證遭外洩，攻擊者在部分客戶組織冒用合法使用者身分，得以在客戶叢集建立未經授權的Pod、讀取Kubernetes Secrets，以及列出叢集節點與儲存磁區。Rackspace接獲客戶通報後確認遭到入侵，平臺隨後暫停存取並清理環境，造成管理主控臺長時間無法使用，客戶也無法管理叢集或輪替可能遭暴露的憑證，直到臺灣時間11月22日凌晨才恢復服務。

items.title: AI 畫錯了自己改：商湯開源 U1.6，多模態模型學會“回頭看”
items.summary: 11月24日，商湯發佈並開源SenseNova U1.6原生多模態模型，延續U系列理解與生成統一範式，首次爲8B開源模型帶來原生圖像自修正。模型先生成首稿，再對照原始提示自查，發現文字錯誤或版式問題後自動生成修正版，由同一模型閉環完成生成與挑錯，減少AI生圖手動返工。

source_material.summary: 書旗中文網2026年度創作者大會在江蘇宜興舉行。面對AI賦能內容生產趨勢，平臺宣佈2027年投入3億元深耕原創內容生態，並升級漫劇扶持。目前書旗已開放超10萬本小說IP供改編。繼2023年承諾三年投入10億元后，平臺持續加碼。AI正貫穿創作、改編與製作全鏈路，推動網絡文學變革。

items.title: “25 萬頁”是玩笑：Claude 黎曼猜想證明爭議，被數學家自己拆了臺

items.title: 修補提速也是一種風險：微軟總裁警告“完美風暴”還會再來
items.summary: 近期全球互聯網接連宕機，微軟Exchange、Outlook、Teams，以及蘋果App Store、多家銀行、航空公司和PSN均受影響。微軟總裁史密斯警告，未來數月全球技術故障風險仍居高不下。官方已排除協同網絡攻擊，魯比奧稱無證據顯示事故彼此相關。史密斯還認爲，AI正改變現狀，令補丁速度跑得比測試更快。

items.title: 螞蟻OceanBase發佈經營數據：AI與全球化成爲新增長點，海外營收同比增長超100%
items.summary: 11月24日，螞蟻OceanBase在北京舉辦AI數據大會，披露2026年經營進展。公司加速邁向AI數據平臺，保持強勁增長，近五年營收復合增長率超60%，增長結構更多元：金融政企核心業務穩定支撐，AI與全球化貢獻新增量，公有云成重要引擎。其AI業務營收超1億元，居國內獨立廠商前列，海外業務亦持續拓展。

items.title: 從“問答”到“辦事”：豆包推出AI個人助理“小豆”，用對話式交互終結日常瑣事焦慮

items.title: MiniMax H3 開源百日交卷：一個模型裂變成 1472 個，下載量突破 1.48 億次

items.title: 螞蟻OceanBase發佈AI數據平臺:統一管理多模態數據，爲Agent提供業務上下文
items.summary: 11月24日，螞蟻OceanBase AI數據大會在京舉行。CEO楊冰稱，模型與Agent基建成熟後，挑戰將回歸數據，AI時代數據基礎設施應堅持“湖庫一體、多模融合、Agent友好、開源開放”。會上，OceanBase發佈湖庫一體AI數據平臺OceanLake，並宣佈向全球開源核心引擎AI數據庫，邀開發者和產業夥伴共建。

items.title: Demo 剛公開就被抄上小程序：一款用AI開發獨遊靠中國玩家扳回兩局
items.summary: 2025年10月，一個不會編程、畫畫的年輕人用AI做遊戲，首條指令是“做一個能用WASD移動的方塊遊戲”。一年後，其一人團隊Optima Arch的《轉運軍團》（slotbound）爆賣：11月13日42元首發九折，6天銷量破20萬套，銷售額近千萬，1800多條評測約80%好評，最高同時在線3.3萬。商店頁坦承視覺與宣傳物料由AI生成，呈現“AI畫皮、人寫骨”模式。

source_material.summary: 2025年10月，一個不會編程、畫畫的年輕人用AI做遊戲，首條指令是“做一個能用WASD移動的方塊遊戲”。一年後，其一人團隊Optima Arch的《轉運軍團》（slotbound）爆賣：11月13日42元首發九折，6天銷量破20萬套，銷售額近千萬，1800多條評測約80%好評，最高同時在線3.3萬。商店頁坦承視覺與宣傳物料由AI生成，呈現“AI畫皮、人寫骨”模式。

items.title: 黃仁勳官復原職：英偉達董事會一週內戲劇性逆轉，股價應聲大漲 31%
items.summary: 英偉達圍繞最高權力的拉鋸不到一週徹底反轉。董事會一致投票通過，恢復黃仁勳總裁、CEO及董事職務；消息公佈後，公司股價隨即大漲31%。而幾天前，董事長哈維·瓊斯還向投資者明確表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳迴歸。董事會解釋，促成逆轉的是幾股力量同時到位，後續會談讓他們對黃仁勳的態度發生改變。

items.title: OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo：給 AI 智能體系統裝上“不打烊的防彈衣”
items.summary: 針對漏洞爆發至補丁落地間的防護真空期，OpenAI於11月24日聯合思科推出開源項目Shirudo。它是一款開源Linux運行時環境，能讓AI智能體在系統不停機前提下直接防護。其核心是讓AI智能體編寫動態eBPF防護規則，藉助eBPF在不修改內核的情況下實現運行時安全，避免系統裸奔或停機等待修復。

items.title: 騙子從郵件打到電話：微軟給 Teams 配了位 AI 反詐員
items.summary: 釣魚攻擊正從郵件轉向通話，冒充IT支持的來電更難識破。11月24日，據Neowin報道，微軟正爲Teams開發AI防詐騙功能，可在通話時分析聊天內容，識別潛在釣魚詐騙跡象並向用戶警告，尤其針對冒充IT管理員的話術。按微軟路線圖，該功能計劃2027年1月向所有用戶開放。

items.title: 補丁要等數週，防護今晚就能上線：OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo
items.summary: 11月23日，OpenAI與思科合作推出開源安全運行時Shirudo。企業修復Linux漏洞常需數天至數週，攻擊者卻不會等。Shirudo基於eBPF，爲運行中系統加裝無需重啓的臨時“盾牌”，持續觀察內核與網絡活動，精準管控可疑行爲，已通過Java4Shell攻擊攔截測試。難點在於漏報等問題。

items.title: 谷歌讓 Gemini 4 智能體“開會”改造量子算法：最高提速 290 倍，還附帶數學正確性證明
items.summary: 量子計算存在算法瓶頸：重要應用即便用最優量子算法，資源需求仍遠超早期硬件。谷歌DeepMind與Google Quantum AI在11月23日發佈研究，提出用多個Gemini4智能體協同優化經典量子算法，生成高效量子電路。量子電路是量子計算機執行運算的基礎，該方案爲緩解算法與硬件資源矛盾提供新思路。

items.title: GPT 6.2 Astra Solves a Historical Mystery
items.summary: GPT 6.2 Astra Solves a Historical Mystery Here's an interesting case-study in using GPT-6.2 Astra for historical research, from history professor Mark Humphries: With only minimal prompting, GPT-6.2 Astra was able to autonomously identify the creator of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale’s Beinecke Library . It did so extremely quickly (in just 22 minutes), using publicly available primary and secondary sources. To do so, it discovered a little known source in a paper archive, predicted that it would prove its hypothesis if examined and, in the end, it did. Not only that, but this new source turns out to be a major find on its own that will be of significant interest to both Canadian and fur trade historians. Here's the digitized sketchbook . Astra found a diary reference reference to a visit by the vicomte de Chabot dated five days before a date mentioned in the sketchbook at a nearby river, and suggested that Chabot's journal of his travels (only available by order from Cleveland State University) might confirm that the sketchbook was his work. Are historians due for a round of Deep Blue ? Mark thinks it will be mild: But if the experience of mathematics is any guide, we can also anticipate that sometime next spring or summer we’ll face a sort of crisis of confidence as we struggle to understand how to respond to agentic systems that can do things human historians cannot. items.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. article_history.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
article_history.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not (yet?) available as open weights. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model. I built a llm-glm plugin , then realized that llm-zai by Tommy Hughes already exists! I've shipped mine purely because llm-zai doesn't yet support the new model, but I'll likely retire mine once that plugin catches up. Here are pelicans for GLM-5.

items_ai.title: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，AI自動審查、修正及核准程式碼
items_ai.summary: Anthropic週一（11/23）宣佈推出Claude Ship，將AI程式開發的自動化範圍從撰寫程式碼延伸至軟體交付流程，讓AI能夠自動審查及修正程式碼，甚至依據企業的自定政策來核准程式碼的變更，目前開放Claude Team及Enterprise使用者測試。 隨著愈來愈多開發人員使用AI代理人撰寫程式碼，後續的人工審查及核准流程可能成為軟體開發的瓶頸。Anthropic表示，旗下Claude Code團隊的大部分程式碼已由Claude撰寫，為了加快提交程式碼後的處理流程，開發了Claude Ship。

items_ai.title: 美國總務署在既有身分驗證智慧卡上成功執行抗量子密碼演算法

items_ai.title: 雲端服務Rackspace Spot遭入侵，攻擊者可讀取客戶叢集內的機密資料
items_ai.summary: Rackspace託管式Kubernetes平臺Spot憑證遭外洩，攻擊者在部分客戶組織冒用合法使用者身分，得以在客戶叢集建立未經授權的Pod、讀取Kubernetes Secrets，以及列出叢集節點與儲存磁區。Rackspace接獲客戶通報後確認遭到入侵，平臺隨後暫停存取並清理環境，造成管理主控臺長時間無法使用，客戶也無法管理叢集或輪替可能遭暴露的憑證，直到臺灣時間11月22日凌晨才恢復服務。

items_ai.title: Demo 剛公開就被抄上小程序：一款用AI開發獨遊靠中國玩家扳回兩局
items_ai.summary: 2025年10月，一個不會編程、畫畫的年輕人用AI做遊戲，首條指令是“做一個能用WASD移動的方塊遊戲”。一年後，其一人團隊Optima Arch的《轉運軍團》（slotbound）爆賣：11月13日42元首發九折，6天銷量破20萬套，銷售額近千萬，1800多條評測約80%好評，最高同時在線3.3萬。商店頁坦承視覺與宣傳物料由AI生成，呈現“AI畫皮、人寫骨”模式。

items_ai.summary: 英偉達圍繞最高權力的拉鋸不到一週徹底反轉。董事會一致投票通過，恢復黃仁勳總裁、CEO及董事職務；消息公佈後，公司股價隨即大漲31%。而幾天前，董事長哈維·瓊斯還向投資者明確表示，董事會無意讓黃仁勳迴歸。董事會解釋，促成逆轉的是幾股力量同時到位，後續會談讓他們對黃仁勳的態度發生改變。

items_ai.title: OpenAI 攜手思科開源 Shirudo：給 AI 智能體系統裝上“不打烊的防彈衣”
items_ai.summary: 針對漏洞爆發至補丁落地間的防護真空期，OpenAI於11月24日聯合思科推出開源項目Shirudo。它是一款開源Linux運行時環境，能讓AI智能體在系統不停機前提下直接防護。其核心是讓AI智能體編寫動態eBPF防護規則，藉助eBPF在不修改內核的情況下實現運行時安全，避免系統裸奔或停機等待修復。

items_ai.title: AI 連代碼合入權都接走了：Anthropic 上線 Claude Ship
items_ai.summary: 11月23日據TechCrunch報道，Anthropic推出Claude Ship測試版，用AI智能體自動化代碼協作中最磨人的代碼審查、修復與批准環節，解決變更積壓、CI全紅、審查人遲遲不看等問題。該工具含三件套：Code Review已正式開放；PR Steward仍在Beta，專處理積壓的“爛攤子PR”，並寫明撤銷方法。

items_ai.title: 谷歌讓 Gemini 4 智能體“開會”改造量子算法：最高提速 290 倍，還附帶數學正確性證明
items_ai.summary: 量子計算存在算法瓶頸：重要應用即便用最優量子算法，資源需求仍遠超早期硬件。谷歌DeepMind與Google Quantum AI在11月23日發佈研究，提出用多個Gemini4智能體協同優化經典量子算法，生成高效量子電路。量子電路是量子計算機執行運算的基礎，該方案爲緩解算法與硬件資源矛盾提供新思路。

It did so extremely quickly (in just 22 minutes), using publicly available primary and secondary sources. To do so, it discovered a little known source in a paper archive, predicted that it would prove its hypothesis if examined and, in the end, it did. Not only that, but this new source turns out to be a major find on its own that will be of significant interest to both Canadian and fur trade historians. Here's the digitized sketchbook . Astra found a diary reference reference to a visit by the vicomte de Chabot dated five days before a date mentioned in the sketchbook at a nearby river, and suggested that Chabot's journal of his travels (only available by order from Cleveland State University) might confirm that the sketchbook was his work. Are historians due for a round of Deep Blue ? items_ai.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
items_ai.summary: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer GLM 5.4 is now available from Chinese AI lab Z.ai. It's their first model to use a looped transformer architecture, which they describe like this: In a standard Transformer, each layer runs once per forward pass. In a Loop Transformer, a group of weight-shared layers runs for multiple iterations, refining the hidden states from the previous pass. This gives us a deeper network without increasing the parameter count. This is the second mention of looped transformers I've seen in the past week - the first was Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab on November 20th, who said: Inkling 2 Mini is a looped transformer, running the middle layers of the model three times for every token. This allows the model to apply more reasoning and reach the right answer with fewer tokens, especially on tasks such as agentic coding that depend on reasoning quality. GLM 5.4 is not yet available as open weights: We plan to open-source the model weights responsibly after completing necessary safety hardening. I tried it out using the Z.ai API, for which I had to sign up for their Coding Plan subscription because 5.4 cannot currently be accessed through the regular API. It turns out both coding plan and regular API share the same OpenAI-compatible Responses API (at https://api.z.ai/api/v1 ), and the API key for the coding plan worked with that and gave me access to the new model.
